I am an Information Systems student at Politeknik Negeri Subang with a primary focus on system analysis, business process modeling, and technical documentation. My academic track record reflects consistent excellence — maintaining a GPA of 3.98/4.00 while actively leading organizations and participating in national-level innovation competitions.

My core expertise lies in System Analysis, Quality Assurance (QA), and Project Management. I have extensive experience in designing system architectures and overseeing the project lifecycle to ensure accuracy and reliability, rather than just technical implementation. I take pride in my meticulous approach to identifying system requirements and optimizing workflows.

Beyond academics, I serve as Vice Chairman of HIMATIKOM (the Informatics Student Association). I have consistently led teams to victory, representing my institution at the national level to win 1st place in hackathons, scientific writing, and innovation contests.

I am also a nationally published author through my contribution to SEMNASTERA 2025, where I focused on the analysis and design of mobile dashboard systems.
